about: Case 222's run: recover failed on its first undo, so both copies are still in idea-mara and idea-tobias. With `Ideas/` writable again, `abandon` at 16:55 exits 0. Every note is byte for byte what it was before `abandon`: the copies stay. Nothing goes on the handled list, the unit index stays empty, the open run is cleared, and the history entry has `how: "abandoned"`, no `renamed`, and no `failed`. The run folder keeps its snapshot.
readings: `write_note_whole` swaps a temp file in beside the note (test_skeleton.py, test_write_note_whole_*), so a read-only note alone can't stop the write; the case makes the note's folder read-only (mode 555) with the runner's `chmod` step, and gives it back (755) before the next command.
The crashed recover is expected to exit 1: the spec doesn't name a code for a recover that fails partway; an uncaught error and a refusal both give 1 (CONTRACT.md 1 item 2).
A migration history entry has no `failed` key (CONTRACT.md 5.6 item 5), and an abandoned one has no `renamed` (04 item 17).
Abandon leaves the unit index as it is: it undoes nothing, so no unit becomes `undone`.
